findings.summary: The flag <Image alt="" aria-hidden width=20 height=15 className="h-[15px] w-5"> markup is duplicated between the trigger (lines 35-42) and the row (lines 72-79). A small FlagIcon helper would remove the duplication.

The design contract test asserts panel chrome (bg/border/radius/padding) and row bounding boxes but never asserts the outer panel's own width/height (spec: 122x124px). It is arithmetically implied by row width (110px) + padding (6px*2) + border (1px*2), so this is a coverage gap, not a defect.

No e2e spec anywhere in the repo directly exercises account-menu.tsx / notification-bell.tsx / quick-action-widget.tsx open/close interactions — regression assurance for those three DropdownMenu consumers rests on source-code inspection (no menuClassName passed) rather than executed behavior. Pre-existing gap, not introduced by this diff, out of scope to fix here.
